integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.

integrity.visual_evidence: Initial navigation to the equipment list shows these specific items are missing at the start of the trajectory.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the names into the application forms.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the 'Add Equipment' form being filled out for each item.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must add exactly three items: 'Resistance Bands', 'TRX Suspension Trainer', and 'Plyo Box'. These items are deleted by the setup script, so they must be created from scratch during the session. The scoring should focus on the visual confirmation of these three specific strings in the wger equipment database GUI.
